description_en: Queries the number of real-time requests for a specified primary domain name
description_zh: 查询指定主域名请求量的实时数据
name: DescribeDomainStatistics

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response.

zh (default): Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。
zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The domain name.<props="china"> Call the DescribeDomains (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) operation to obtain the domain name.</props>
<props="intl">Call the DescribeDomains (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) operation to obtain the domain name.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
域名名称。<props="china">可通过调取DescribeDomains (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)接口获取</props>
<props="intl">可通过调取DescribeDomains (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)接口获取</props>
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The start date of the query. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

You can query records only from the last 90 days. This means `StartDate >= Now - 90`
parameters.help_zh:
查询的开始时间，格式：YYYY-MM-DD。

只能查询最近90天的记录，即：`StartDate >= Now - 90`
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en:
The end date of the query. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

The default value is the current date
parameters.help_zh:
查询的结束时间，格式：YYYY-MM-DD。

默认为查询当天的时间
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en:
The type of the domain name. Valid values:

PUBLIC: The domain name is hosted on Alibaba Cloud DNS (default).

CACHE: Alibaba Cloud DNS is used as a proxy for the domain name
parameters.help_zh:
域名类型，取值：

PUBLIC：权威托管域名（默认值）

CACHE：权威代理域名
parameters.name: domain_type
